style.styleTitle: Premier Decorations Ltd 60cm Pre Glittery Crestwood Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Add a warm and elegant finishing touch to your Christmas decorations with this 60 cm pre-lit Glittery Crestwood Christmas wreath. Enhanced by 50 warm white LEDs, it creates a soft, welcoming glow that complements the glittering foliage. Battery operated for flexible placement, it also features a convenient timer function to make enjoying your display effortless. Perfect for hanging on doors, walls or throughout your home, this illuminated wreath brings classic seasonal style to any space.
